author: Corridor Crew
description:
F1: The movie ran a marketing campaign that strongly emphasized how much of the production was done practically, often directly downplaying the scale of its VFX, which, in reality, was quite significant. So much so that they are nominated for the category of best VFX at the Oscars!

Did you know that so much of the movie relied on VFX?
title: So, did THEY use CGI or NOT?
